summary.text: Ronny Johns is a Republican and a native of Ada who has represented Oklahoma House District 25 since 2018.

paragraphs.text: Johns is the son of two educators and a graduate of Byng High School, and he earned both his bachelor’s and master’s degrees from East Central University.

Before being elected, he spent 32 years as an educator in the Ada City School System, working as a teacher, coach, athletic coordinator and vice-principal, and he was principal at Ada Jr. High when elected.
His wife, Renee, has worked in education for 30 years, and they have three children and four grandchildren.
